works.title: Elite Misconduct Pattern Reference Archive
works.description: A structured reference archive cataloging recurring patterns of elite misconduct across decades, enabling rapid pattern identification and multi-decade exemplar rosters for political writing and analysis.
works.quote: Build a well-scoped reference archive so that when a real article about elite misconduct lands, the voice can instantly slot it into a known recurring pattern, name the structurally true claim that explains the pattern, and reel off a multi-decade roster of canonical exemplars

works.title: Ideation Framework
works.description: A systematic methodology for transforming raw creative material into organized, implementable narrative elements using character choice architecture and universal human pattern recognition, with explicit layers for material analysis and narrative application.
works.quote: This framework transforms raw creative material into organized, implementable narrative elements. It uses character choice architecture and universal human pattern recognition to distill broad concepts into a target of concise, formatted story beats

works.title: Plot Refinement Framework
works.description: A comprehensive system for creating tactical prose generation blueprints from strategic plot structure, converting abstract plot and character arcs into choice-driven narrative roadmaps with consequence mapping and bridge-event identification for chapter-by-chapter drafting.
works.quote: A Comprehensive System for Creating Tactical Prose Generation Blueprints. Transform strategic plot structure from the Plot Foundation Framework into a tactical prose generation blueprint for chapter-by-chapter drafting

works.title: Ruth Justice Voice Specification
works.description: A voice specification and rhetorical device guide for the Ruth Justice character, establishing stylistic direction with elder-voiced punch-up contempt, extracting transferable rhetorical devices from Molly Ivins and classical rhetoric sources (accumulatio, declarative closers, word economy).
works.quote: Give Claude Code a stylistic North Star for how Ruth Justice sounds — composed, elder-voiced, punch-up contempt; hot conviction, cold delivery. Curate the tradition and extract the transferable devices.
